title: "Export" buttons do nothing
detail: No download and no network request on EO Billing, Enquiries, RSVPs, Event services, Guest list and Vendor RFQs, Invoices, Listing. (Guest list per-event CSV does work.)

title: EDM packages never load after choosing a listing
detail: /vendor/edm: selecting any listing shows no EDM packages and no API call is made; Continue stays disabled, so a vendor cannot buy an EDM.

title: Billing summary does not match the invoice list
detail: Summary says 6 invoices / $2,027; the list (All, page 1 of 1) shows 5 invoices totalling $1,155.

title: Credits packages show lorem ipsum
detail: /vendor/credits and its summary: "Buy credits to lorem ipsum dolor sit amet", "Use to buy lorem ipsum…".

title: HE Services pages reuse RSVP wording
detail: HE Services selection is titled "HatchEvent RSVP Menu"; summary says "What happens after you purchased a RSVP Package?" and lists an "RSVP Services contract/invoice".

title: Draft events appear under "Ongoing Events" on Guest List
detail: Drafts (e.g. "Portal review test December 2026", "UAT-AUTO Wizard Draft") are listed as ongoing events on Event guest list, but not on RSVPs.

title: Junk invite template "ergergerg" offered to EOs
detail: Step "Upload your e-Invite background" lists a template named "ergergerg" next to the real templates.

title: Wizard back/forward buttons have no accessible name
detail: The arrow buttons around "Save for later" have no text/aria-label; screen readers announce only "button".

title: "Follow Us" social icons link to "#"
detail: All five social icons in the footer have href="#".

title: Wizard time field: choosing PM before typing saves an AM time; retyping is ignored
detail: (1) Choose PM, then type 02:00 → field flips back to AM and the server receives 02:00 (not 14:00). (2) A field that already has a time ignores new typing: 09:00 → type 04:00 → still 09:00; choosing PM then shows 21:00. (3) Typing 04:00 then PM displays "16:00 PM" (value sent is correct, display is confusing). (4) 12:00 AM displays as "00:00 AM". Repro on /events/create/wizard/details.

title: Event cards cannot be expanded with the keyboard
detail: Collapsed event cards (Past events) expand only by mouse — the header is a <div> without role/tabindex.

title: Draft events cannot be deleted
detail: Draft cards offer only Edit event name and Edit dates. Every "Save for later" leaves a permanent draft. Intended?

title: Opening "Create my own listing" reserves a listing number
detail: Clicking Continue calls POST /vendor-listings/listing-number before anything is entered ("Listing no: 4 / 4"). Abandoned attempts may consume numbers.

title: Overlay opacity shown as 0.4 but saved as 0
detail: The design editor slider shows 0.4; the saved payload sends overlay_opacity: 0. Check the saved invite matches the editor (related to BUG-21).

title: Gold fee $2,400 vs "Total price including VAT/GST $711.03"
detail: Membership record for the current Gold cycle shows a total far below the fee. Pro-rated upgrade, or wrong figure?

title: No way to edit the EO profile on web; odd test data
detail: Profile is read-only on web. Important dates include "41920801893 - 13 Jan 2026".

title: /events/create/ai is reachable without login
detail: Confirm this public entry point is intended.

title: Edit RSVP takes ~10 s on a blank loading screen
detail: /eo/rsvp/loading shows only the header/footer for about 10 seconds before the first step.

title: Hydration-mismatch console error on EO pages
detail: Vue reports a hydration mismatch on load; harmless to users today but often hides real rendering bugs.

title: Intermittent 500 on /api/proxy/sanctum/csrf-cookie
detail: Seen once during the full run (EO-TC-12, opening a vendor preview). The page recovered, but a 500 on the CSRF endpoint can cause random 419/login failures.
